_comment: The minimal close-gate manifest an adopter has after bootstrap. It DELIBERATELY omits user_story_glob and closure_declaration -- those omissions are what make close-gate.sh's two adopter-only branches reachable. Adding either key silently disarms half this fixture.
_comment_test_command: It writes THROUGH {EVIDENCE_FILE}, exactly as the shipped .claude/close-gate.json.example does -- gen-test-evidence.sh refuses a runner that writes to its own report file instead of through the placeholder. No python3 here on purpose, so the payload is an echo rather than validate.py.
test_command: { bash scripts/close-gate.sh evidence-header {SET}; echo adopter-stub; } | tee {EVIDENCE_FILE}
